item.title: Synthesis is harder than analysis
item.description:

item.title: Odin, Wikipedia and engagement farming
item.description:
📝 What is this "Articles for Deletion Odin (Programming Language)", oh no, that doesn't sound good. Being a little bit lax with my language, the majority's consensus agreed that Odin isn't notable, and the article had no reliable sources. We don't particularly care if Odin is on Wikipedia or not; especially when Wikipedia itself is rarely reliable, but we've been dealing with Wikipedia mods for years.
🔗 Read more: https://katamari64.se/posts/2026/odin-wikipedia/

item.title: Maybe you should learn something
item.description:
📝 All this is your brain and muscles getting tired. You should go in with this expectation. You’ll want to pace yourself, daily deliberate practice is what makes you better.
🔗 Read more: https://www.marginalia.nu/log/a_135_learn/
